_comment: The monsters' moves (docs/gameplay/13_BATTLE_EDITOR.md §6.1, 6.2; src/core/game/systems/battle_rules.h). A monster
lists the ones it may use in enemies.json "moves" (an id, or {"id", "weight"}); without a list it only strikes.
Its next move shows over it with the time left (its intent), so the player can answer it:
kind strike: a plain attack; guard to soften it.
kind heavy: a perfect guard (the guard bar's power at data/battle.json break.parryPower or more) parries it: no
damage, the monster staggers and takes more damage for a while.
kind jabs: hits quick hits; they do not wait for a running combo and cut it short. Guard instead.
kind spell: a combo matching breakHits points or more breaks it; a guard only halves it.
kind guard: it deals no damage; hits on it do reduce of their damage, but a fully charged attack breaks the guard.
damage: times its attack; time: its wind-up, times its attack interval; text: the intent's words (text.json key).
Its rhythm (docs/gameplay/16 §4.1): chargeMs (the wind-up in ms, in place of time), hits with gapsMs (one value or one
per gap: the time before each next hit), warnMs (the "!" over it before each hit; default battle.json guard.warnMs);
guardPlay: a skills.json id: a special guard play (draw a seal, tap fast) in place of the guard button (16 §4.3).
